title: Shuru karne se pehle
intro: AutoLoom wholesale ka app hai: supplier se maal aata hai, godown mein rehta hai, dukaan aur bande ke khaate par ya cash mein bikta hai. Do tarah ke log chalate hain — Partner (maalik) aur Staff (ladke).

pages.title: Login
pages.what: Email aur password wahi jo maalik ne aapke liye banaya hai.
steps: EMAIL mein apna email likho — naam nahi, email.
PASSWORD daalo, phir “Kholo” dabao.
pages.note: Pehli baar login ke baad app saara maal aur khata phone mein utaar leta hai — ek-do minute lagte hain. Uske baad signal na ho tab bhi app chalta hai; net aate hi sab apne aap server par chala jaata hai.

pages.title: Ghar — pehli screen
pages.what: Din ka haal ek nazar mein. Upar “Bill Banao” aur “Stock Chadhao”, beech mein aaj ke number, neeche aaj kya-kya hua.
steps: Neeche paanch tab: Ghar · Stock · Khata · Bill (partner ke liye Hisab) · Aur.
Partner ko aaj ki sale, kharcha, munafa aur stock ki keemat dikhti hai.
Staff ko aaj ke bill ki ginti dikhti hai — sale ka total, kharid rate aur munafa sirf partner dekhte hain.
“Approval baaki” dikhe to staff ne maal likha hai — tap karke approve karo.

pages.title: Laal “+ Nayi entry” — saare kaam yahin se
pages.what: Neeche daayein laal button. Jo aapka role kar sakta hai, sirf wahi kaam dikhte hain.
steps: Stock Chadhao — supplier se maal aaya.
Bill Banao — maal diya.
Paisa Aaya — grahak ne udhaar ka paisa diya.
Kharcha Likho — chai, bhada, transport.
Kharab Likho — maal toota ya kharab nikla.
Ginti Karo — godown ka maal gino.

title: Roz ka kaam
intro: Maal aaya, maal gaya, paisa aaya, kharcha hua — inhe theek se likho, baaki hisaab apne aap banta hai.

pages.title: Stock Chadhao — supplier se maal aaya
pages.what: Kis supplier se aaya, kya aaya, kitna aaya. Staff ki entry owner ke approval ke baad hi stock mein judti hai.
steps: Supplier chuno. Naya ho to naam likho aur “+ Naya banao”.
Maal scan karo ya naam likho — socket, gaadi sab list mein dikhta hai. “Kitne aaye” gin ke likho.
Supplier ke bill ki photo laga sakte ho (zaroori nahi).
Staff: “… pcs owner ko bhejo”. Owner gin ke dekhega, rate bharega, approve karega.
Partner: kharid rate bhar do (zaroori nahi) aur “… pcs chadha do” — stock turant badhega.
Staff: galti dikhi to “Aur” → “Maine kya bheja” → “Review mein” wali entry kholo, theek karo, “Ho gaya” — approve hone tak badal sakte ho.
pages.note: Approve hone tak wo maal stock mein nahi ginta — na bill par dikhega, na Hisab mein. Approve ya mana hone ke baad entry sirf partner badal sakta hai; “Maine kya bheja” mein dikhta hai kya hua aur kyun.

pages.title: Bill Banao
pages.what: “Kaun le raha hai” mein pehle se “Cash Grahak” hota hai — turant paisa dene wala. Khata wali dukaan ya banda ho to uska naam chuno.
steps: Grahak chuno. Naya ho to naam likh ke “+ Naya banao” — khata ban ke bill par wapas aa jaata hai.
Maal scan karo ya naam likho. Qty aur rate dekh lo.
“Paisa kaise aaya” — Cash, Online / UPI, Card, Bank. Khata wale grahak ke liye “Udhaar” bhi.
“Bill bana do”. Stock kam ho gaya, udhaar ho to khaate mein chadh gaya.
pages.note: Cash Grahak ka udhaar nahi hota — udhaar dena hai to us dukaan ya bande ka khata banao. Stock kam ho to app poochhta hai “Phir bhi bill banayein?”.

pages.title: Bana hua bill
pages.what: Kitne ka tha, kitna mila, kitna baaki — aur us bill par aage kya karna hai.
steps: “Jama laga do” — udhaar ka paisa aaya to yahin se.
“WhatsApp parchi” — grahak ko parchi bhejo.
“PDF / print” — bill print karo ya PDF share karo.
“Maal wapas” — grahak maal lauta raha hai. Theek hai to stock mein wapas; kharab hai to “Kharab · supplier ko jayega”.

pages.title: Paisa Aaya
pages.what: Grahak ne udhaar ka paisa diya. Rakam aur tareeka likho — purane bill se pehle kat-ta hai.
steps: Grahak chuno; “Poora paisa” dabao to poora baaki bhar jaata hai.
Kaise aaya — Cash, Online / UPI, Bank, Cheque, Card.
“Paisa likh do”. Mobile ho to app poochhega “WhatsApp par bhej dein?”.

pages.title: Kharcha Likho
pages.what: Business ka paisa bahar gaya — chai, bhada, transport, packing. ₹40 ki chai bhi likho, tabhi din ka cash milega.
steps: Kitna, kis cheez ka (chip dabao), kaise diya, kisne diya.
“₹… ka kharcha likh do”.
pages.note: Partner ne apne liye paisa nikala to wo yahan nahi — “Partner ka paisa” mein likho.

title: Approval — partner ke liye
intro: Staff jo maal likhta hai wo seedha stock mein nahi jaata. Partner gin ke dekhta hai, rate bharta hai, phir approve.

pages.title: Approval ki list
pages.what: “Aur” → “Approval”, ya Stock / Ghar par “Approval baaki”. Staff ka aaya hua maal aur naye item ki request — dono yahan.
steps: “Aaya hua maal — approve karo” mein entry par tap karo.
“Naye item” mein staff ki bheji item request — dekho, haan ya mana.

pages.title: Approve karna
pages.what: Staff ne kya likha, kitna — aur har item ka kharid rate bharne ki jagah.
steps: Qty sahi hai na — dekh lo, zaroorat ho to badal do.
Har item ka “Kharid rate” bharo. Pichhla rate dikh raha ho to “₹… lagao” dabao.
“Approve karo — stock chadhao”. Stock badh gaya aur supplier ke khaate mein sahi rakam chadh gayi.
Kuch galat hai to wajah likh ke “Wapas bhejo” — staff theek karke dobara bhejega. Bilkul nahi lena to wajah likh ke “Mana karo”.
“Badla gaya” dikhe to staff ne bhejne ke baad badla hai — jo screen par hai wahi taaza hai.
pages.note: Rate abhi na pata ho to bina rate bhi approve kar sakte ho — wo item Stock tab ke “Rate baaki” mein dikhega. Jaldi bhar dena, warna uski bikri poora munafa dikhegi.

title: Stock aur maal
intro: Godown mein kya, kitna pada hai — aur har item ki poori detail: category, socket, gaadi, saal.

pages.title: Stock tab
pages.what: Upar Godown aur Kharab maal ke dabbe, neeche saara maal — har item ke saath uski detail (socket, watt) aur kis gaadi mein lagta hai.
steps: SKU, barcode, naam, socket ya gaadi likh ke dhoondo.
“Kam hai” — jaldi khatam hone wala. “Khatam” — bilkul nahi bacha.
“Rate baaki” (sirf partner) — jis maal ka kharid rate abhi tak nahi bhara.
Item par tap karo to uska poora page khulta hai.
pages.note: Kharab maal bechne wale stock mein nahi ginta — bill par sirf godown ka maal aata hai.

pages.title: Rate baaki
pages.what: Bina rate ke aaya maal. Item kholo → “Badlo” → “Kharid rate” bharo → “Badlav kar do”.
pages.note: Rate bharne se pehle jo maal bik gaya uski cost ₹0 gini jaati hai, aur Hisab mein uska poora daam munafa dikhta hai.

pages.title: Item ka page
pages.what: Upar Spec — category, socket, watt, colour jaisi detail — aur “Kis gaadi mein lagta hai”, saal ke saath. Phir godown mein kitna, kharab mein kitna, rate.
steps: Gaadi par tap karo to us gaadi ka page khulta hai.
“Aana-jaana ka hisaab” — kab aaya, kab gaya, kisne kiya.
Partner ko kharid rate aur kharid ka hisaab bhi dikhta hai; staff ko nahi.

pages.title: Naya item / item badlo
pages.what: Category chuno — uske hisaab se detail ke dabbe khulte hain: bulb mein socket (H4, H7…), watt, colour; mat mein type, colour.
steps: Category, item ka naam, qty, bechne ka rate. Partner kharid rate bhi bhar sakta hai.
“Detail” mein jo pata ho bharo — socket zaroori hai, baaki chahe to.
“Kis gaadi mein lagta hai” — company + model chuno, saal se–tak likho, “+ Gaadi jodo”. Kai gaadi jod sakte ho. Har gaadi mein lagta ho to “Sab gaadi”.
“Item bana do” / “Badlav kar do”. Staff ke liye ye request ban ke partner ke paas jaati hai.

Wahi item doosri gaadi ya colour ke liye? Naya item mat banao — item ke page par “+ Nayi gaadi / kism”: naam, category aur detail wahi rehti hai, sirf gaadi, saal, colour chuno. Naya naam likhte hi “Ye item pehle se hai?” bhi dikhta hai.
pages.note: Jo detail bharoge wahi stock list, bill ki search aur item ke page par dikhegi — jaise “H4 · 60/55W · Creta 2019–2023”.

pages.title: Gaadi ka page
pages.what: “Aur” → “Dhoondo” se gaadi likho (jaise “creta”). Har model-saal ke bulb socket, us gaadi ka maal, aur socket se lagne wale bulb.
steps: “Model aur bulb” — har saal ke headlight, fog ke socket.
“Lagne wala maal” — is gaadi se joda hua maal, stock ke saath.
“Socket se lagne wale bulb” — jo bulb is gaadi ke socket ka hai, chahe gaadi se joda na ho.

pages.title: Ginti Karo
pages.what: Godown mein jitna gina wo likho. App ke stock se farak ho to theek ho jaata hai.
steps: Maal scan karo ya naam likho, “Ginti mein kitna nikla” likho.
Farak ki wajah chuno, “… item theek kar do” → “Haan, ginti theek kar do”.

pages.title: Kya mangwana hai
pages.what: Jo tezi se bik raha hai aur khatam hone wala hai — supplier ko order dene se pehle dekho.

title: Kharab maal → supplier → replacement
intro: Toota ya kharab maal fenka nahi jaata: alag rakha jaata hai, supplier ko wapas jaata hai, aur uske badle replacement ya paisa aata hai.

pages.title: Kharab Likho
pages.what: Maal toota, kharab nikla, supplier se kharab aaya, ya grahak ne kharab lautaya.
steps: “Nayi entry” → “Kharab Likho”. Kya hua chuno.
Maal aur kitne pcs daalo, “… pcs kharab mein daalo”.
Wo godown se nikal ke “Kharab maal” mein chala jaata hai.
pages.note: “Nahi mila” (gum ho gaya) alag hai — wo stock se hat jaata hai aur nuksan Hisab mein judta hai.

pages.title: Kharab maal — supplier ko wapas
pages.what: “Aur” → “Kharab maal”. Abhi kharab mein kya pada hai, aur kaunsi wapsi supplier ke paas settle hone baaki hai.
steps: Partner: “Supplier ko wapas bhejo” → supplier chuno → maal aur pcs → “Wapsi likh do”. Supplier ke khaate se itna kam ho jaata hai.
Supplier replacement de: wapsi kholo → “Replacement aaya” → jitna aaya utna → chadha do. Poora aa gaya to wapsi apne aap settle.
Supplier paisa kaat de (doosre maal mein adjust): wapsi par “Paisa mein adjust karo”.
Theek nikla to “Theek nikla — godown”; bilkul bekaar to “Fenk do” — tab nuksan Hisab mein judta hai.
pages.note: Kuch replacement, kuch paisa — dono chalta hai. “Supplier ke paas — settle baaki” khaali rakho.

title: Khata
intro: Har dukaan, har bande ka apna khata. Kisse kitna lena hai, kisko kitna dena hai.

pages.title: Khata tab — grahak
pages.what: Upar do dabbe: “Grahak — lena hai” aur “Supplier — dena hai”. Neeche har khata aur uska baaki.
steps: Naam, firm, mobile ya shehar likh ke dhoondo. Dealer, Thok, Retail se chhaanto.
“Naya grahak” — dukaan ya bande ka naam aur mobile kaafi hai.
Kisi khaate par tap karo to poora hisaab khulta hai.
pages.note: Cash Grahak yahan nahi dikhta — uska koi khata nahi hota.

pages.title: Khata tab — supplier
pages.what: Saare supplier aur kisko kitna dena hai (rakam sirf partner ko dikhti hai). Supplier kholo to usse aaya maal aur wapsi dikhti hai.

pages.title: Ek grahak ka khata
pages.what: Kitna baaki hai, kab kya liya, kab paisa diya — har line ke baad kitna baaki.
steps: “Naya bill” — isi grahak ka bill.
“Paisa aa gaya” — grahak ne paisa diya.
“Yaad dilao” — WhatsApp par baaki ki yaad.
“Hisaab bhejo” — poora khata WhatsApp par.

pages.title: Yaad dilao
pages.what: Kisse kitna paisa lena hai, aur WhatsApp par yaad dilana.
steps: “Sabko bhejo” — har baar dabane par agle grahak ka WhatsApp khulta hai, message likha hua.
Ek hi grahak ko bhejna ho to uske aage “Yaad dilao”.

title: Hisab, partner ka paisa, report — partner ke liye
intro: Sale, munafa, partner ki poonji aur har cheez ki PDF.

pages.title: Hisab tab
pages.what: Aaj, 7 Din, Is Mahine ya apni tareekh. Sale, maal ki cost, maal par munafa, kharcha, kharab/nuksan aur asli munafa.
steps: Kisi bhi line par tap karo to uske peeche ki entries khulti hain.
Upar “Saari entries”, “Report — PDF”, “Partner ka paisa”.
pages.note: Grahak ka wapas kiya maal Sale aur cost dono se ghat jaata hai. Partner ka paisa munafa ya kharcha nahi ginta.

pages.title: Saari entries
pages.what: Din bhar ke bill, aaya maal, kharcha, paisa — time ke saath. Staff ke liye yahi “Bill” tab hai.
steps: Aaj, Kal, 7 din, Is mahine ya koi bhi tareekh.
“Adhoore bill” dikhe to wo poore nahi hue — tap karke poora karo ya “Chhod do”.

pages.title: Partner ka paisa
pages.what: Kis partner ne business mein kab kitna lagaya aur kitna nikala. Upar business mein kul poonji aur har partner ka hisaab.
steps: Partner chuno, “Paisa lagaya” ya “Paisa nikala”.
Kitna, tareekh, kaise (Cash, UPI, Bank, Cheque), note.
“… likh do”. Galat entry par tap karke cancel kar sakte ho.
“PDF” se poora hisaab nikal lo.

pages.title: Report — PDF
pages.what: Report chuno, din chuno, PDF banao — print karo ya WhatsApp par bhejo.
steps: Sale — har din ke bill, grahak aur item ke hisaab se.
Party ka khata — grahak ya supplier ka poora hisaab, baaki ke saath.
Stock — godown aur kharab, aaj tak.
Munafa, Partner ka paisa, Kharcha.
Din: Aaj, Kal, 7 din, Is mahine, Pichhla mahina, Is saal (April se), ya apni tareekh.

title: Maalik ke kaam
intro: Ye screens sirf partner aur admin ko dikhti hain.

pages.title: Admin
pages.what: Staff, approvals, maal aur dukaan ki settings — sab ek jagah.

pages.title: Staff aur role
pages.what: Teen role: Partner (maalik — sab kuch), Admin (maalik jaisa), Staff (ladke — maal likhna, bill, paisa, kharcha, kharab, ginti).
steps: “+ Naya staff” — naam, email, password, role.
Kisi par tap karke role badlo, band karo, ya naya password do.
Kharid rate, munafa, nuksan, partner ka paisa aur report sirf Partner aur Admin dekhte hain.

title: Baaki sab
intro: Jo roz nahi chahiye par kabhi-kabhi kaam aata hai.

pages.title: Aur
pages.what: Jo tab mein nahi, wo sab: Dhoondo, Yaad dilao, Kharab maal, Ginti, Supplier se aaya maal, Paisa, Partner ka paisa, Report, Approval, settings.

pages.title: Sync ka haal
pages.what: Phone ka data server tak gaya ya nahi. “JUDA HUA” dikhe to sab theek. Koi entry server ne mana ki ho to wo yahan aur ek laal message mein dikhti hai.

pages.title: Kaise chalayein — app ke andar
pages.what: Yahi manual app ke andar bhi hai: “Aur” → “Kaise chalayein”. Har kaam ka button seedha wahin se khulta hai.
